page_title: GIR 1-1 RMA | Girona v Real Madrid 30/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

raw: van de Beek D. Achilles Tendon Injury

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the right post.
90+4' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) serves up a nice cross, but Paulo Gazzaniga punches the ball away.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Xabi Alonso prepares a substitution. Trent Alexander-Arnold is replaced by Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid).
90' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) is coming onto the pitch as Fran Garcia cannot continue after picking up an injury.
89' Axel Witsel (Girona) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
88' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
87' Abel Ruiz (Girona) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
87' Looks like Abel Ruiz (Girona) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
86' Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle and it's Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

84' Joel Roca (Girona) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Thibaut Courtois anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the left side of the target.
83' Michel has decided to substitute Azzedine Ounahi and he is replaced by Abel Ruiz (Girona).
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vladyslav Vanat departs the field of play to be replaced by Lass Kourouma (Girona).
82' A rebound falls to Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
81' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
81' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
80' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
79' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just over the bar.
78' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Paulo Gazzaniga as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
77' Alejandro Frances (Girona) is penalised for holding. Ricardo De Burgos signals a set piece.
76' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid). Ricardo De Burgos saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
74' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) was quite harsh and Ricardo De Burgos didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
74' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
73' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

73' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
72' Substitution. Aurelien Tchouameni leaves the pitch and is replaced by Rodrygo (Real Madrid).
72' Substitution. Alejandro Frances (Girona) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Hugo Rincon walks off.
72' Michel decides to make a substitution. Bryan Gil will be replaced by Joel Roca (Girona).
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Viktor Tsygankov trots off the pitch and is replaced by Yaser Asprilla (Girona).

72' Vitor Reis (Girona) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies inches wide of the right-hand post.
71' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) takes a direct free kick.

71' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Girona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
69' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header directed into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop his effort.
68' Axel Witsel (Girona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Ricardo De Burgos has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
68' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
67' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Paulo Gazzaniga no chance!
66' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

65' Hugo Rincon (Girona) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Ricardo De Burgos blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Real Madrid are awarded a penalty!
63' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
62' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
59' Caution goes to Azzedine Ounahi (Girona).

57' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Thibaut Courtois leaps like a salmon to deny him.
56' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but the ball is blocked by one of his teammates.

54' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Paulo Gazzaniga shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
51' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Paulo Gazzaniga, who smothers the ball.
50' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
46' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Xabi Alonso probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Arda Guler. He is replaced by Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid).
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Ricardo De Burgos blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' 1 - 0 Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball into the top right corner in trademark fashion.
42' After what seems an eternity, referee Ricardo De Burgos decides there was a handball after using VAR to review the goal! NO GOAL for Real Madrid, play to continue.
42' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Real Madrid players aren’t happy.
42' Paulo Gazzaniga (Girona) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
40' Goal! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:1.
40' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
39' Paulo Gazzaniga makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Eder Militao (Real Madrid) after a cross from the side.
38' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) works the corner short.
37' Real Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
33' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
32' The resulting corner from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
32' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The ball is out of play. Real Madrid win a corner kick.
30' Alex Moreno (Girona) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
30' Girona take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
29' An attempted cross from Alex Moreno (Girona) is cleared. Girona have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
27' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
26' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is unlucky with a low drive from the edge of the box. A decent save by Thibaut Courtois stops the ball from hitting the middle of the net.
26' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
23' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles over the bar.
22' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Jude Bellingham, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
20' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) is penalised for a foul. Ricardo De Burgos had a clear view and blows his whistle.
19' A pass by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
16' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.
15' The resulting corner from Arda Guler (Real Madrid) is cleared by the defence.
14' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Real Madrid force their opponents to concede a corner.
12' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
12' The ball falls kindly for Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just over the bar.
11' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
9' Fine attempt! Arda Guler (Real Madrid) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
8' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Paulo Gazzaniga intercepts the ball.
5' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.

5' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Girona are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
2' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Real Madrid will have the kick-off.
Ricardo De Burgos will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
